content.text: Retry when ubuntu switches to gcc6
and conditionally wrap one piece of code with somethign to disable the bug. Re-evaluate if this issue is fixed in the future.
// Crazy warning - cuz its NOT ignored - it works around probable bug with stack-use-after-scope
{ #if qDebug ::memcpy (fGuard1_, kGuard1_, sizeof (kGuard1_)); ::memcpy (fGuard2_, kGuard2_, sizeof (kGuard2_)); #endif Invariant (); }
- no_sanitize() attribute doesnt work til gcc 8, and by then they may have fixed the underlying bug.
worked a little better for gcc7.2 on arm, but not fully (not on

COULD try no_sanitize("vptr") maybe - but lets just give this a rest and retry with gcc8.
RETEST WHEN WE HAVE GCC 8 arm cross compiler
